cause_claim: The change adds rule-0291 specifying only 2 criteria fields (f01, f13) out of template T4's 13 total fields. The rule-validator validates against field_count=13 but does not reject incomplete criteria (0 rejected in candidate run). However, content-interpreter.load_rules expects 12 inputs supplied (contract ic-0006) and fails with exit_code=3 because rule-0291 only references 2 fields, creating a slot mismatch: "rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)". The measured values: baseline exit_code=0 → candidate exit_code=3; the 12-input expectation (ic-0006) vs. 2-field rule coverage causes the failure.
